title: Combined authorities, December 2025 (England, generalised, clipped)
description: English combined authorities and combined county authorities. ONS reports some local area statistics against these, including the life expectancy series held here.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "Combined_Authorities_December_2025_Boundaries_EN_BGC" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/Combined_Authorities_December_2025_Boundaries_EN_BGC/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 15 features in WGS84. The portal serves this product through the API rather than as a named download, so the file is named for the layer and reproduced by rerunning that query rather than by filename.
